description: Blocks destructive database drops, cache wipes, volume teardowns, and force pushes to main branches.

rules.name: sql_drop_or_truncate_database
rules.description: Blocks DROP DATABASE, DROP SCHEMA, TRUNCATE TABLE, and Redis FLUSHALL/FLUSHDB commands.
rules.message: Blocked destructive database or cache wipe command. Require explicit human execution.

rules.name: infra_destructive_teardown
rules.description: Blocks terraform destroy, pulumi destroy, kubectl delete namespace/pvc, and docker compose down -v.
rules.message: Blocked destructive infrastructure or volume teardown command.

rules.name: git_force_push_main
rules.description: Blocks git push --force or -f targeting main or master.
rules.message: Blocked force push to main/master branch.
